contents.name: All limit ordinals and cardinals have cofinality omega

contents.name: Every uncountable cardinal is singular
contents.support: Inside the completed ZF model, every infinite cardinal is a limit ordinal; cofinality omega is then strictly below each uncountable cardinal.

alternatives.argument: Run Abraham's two-form argument. The first finite side-condition poset has countable-model master conditions and yields an uncountable outside set unless there is a countable inside cover. The second finite-colouring poset is ccc by Delta-system thinning and partitions the base into outside sets. The two forms yield the simple alternative; no P-ideal hypothesis is introduced.

Abraham's official slides 1–4 give the complete topology reduction: regularity supplies closed initial neighbourhoods, the inside case defeats every countable dense set, and the outside case yields an uncountable discrete subset.
